title: Ikea ditches plans for new UK stores, blaming high business taxes
summary_full: Retailer’s British boss says John Healey ‘missed opportunity to back retailers’ in October’s budgetBusiness live – latest updatesIkea has ditched some planned store openings in the UK blaming the cost of business taxes, which it said were the highest in Europe.As its annual UK sales little more than flatlined at the Swedish flatpack furniture retailer, its UK boss, David McCabe, said: “There are locations where we were planning to open a new unit, and those plans have been abandoned due to the cost that we experience and the complexity within the market.
